digest.component_or_area: reconciler package structure and import infrastructure
propositions: The reconciler package at src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/ uses by-path loaders (lazy_load, spec_from_file_location, sys.path.insert, hand-rolled try/except ImportError prologues) scattered across 47 source files and 343 test files, violating namespace hygiene and forcing a sys.modules contract.
The generic top-level name 'rebar_reconciler' widens engine annotations to Any in mypy and must be replaced with the fully qualified package name 'rebar.reconciler' with no re-export shim.
The PYTHONPATH prepend in src/rebar/_engine.py::engine_env and four sys.path.insert sites in CLI and command modules must be deleted after moving the package to a top-level namespace.

The .github/complexity-baseline.json file has six function complexity keys under src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/ (outbound_fields.py, applier.py, binding_walk.py, dispatch_one.py, inbound_differ.py, outbound_field_diff.py) that must be re-spelled to src/rebar/reconciler/ with unchanged ceilings and the map re-sorted.
The MCP server and library loaders (mcp_server.py, _lib_ops.py, _bridge_commands.py) that dynamically load engine modules by path must be rewritten to use plain imports from rebar.reconciler.

All test-side loader infrastructure (spec_from_file_location helpers, sys.modules seeds, _ENGINE_DIR, sys.path.insert, importlib.reload) must be deleted and replaced with direct importlib.import_module or monkeypatch.setattr on shared modules.
